tracks.title: Golden Hour Map
tracks.theme: A hopeful reflection on waking up in a new city with endless possibilities ahead.
tracks.lyrics:
[verse]
Sunlight cuts the blinds
Dust motes dance and spin
I haven't learned the streets
But I let them in
Coffee steam rises slow
Like a question mark
Waiting for the answer
To be played at heart

[chorus]
Oh, the sky is wide open blue
Everything feels brand new
No map needed here
Just the air and fear
Of what might go wrong
Or right, or strong
This morning belongs to me
Wild and free

[verse]
Footsteps on the pavement
Start their quiet song
Shadows stretch and lengthen
In the early light where we belong
Every corner holds a secret
Every door a chance
Building castles out of moments
Leading to a dance

[chorus]
Oh, the sky is wide open blue
Everything feels brand new
No map needed here
Just the air and fear
Of what might go wrong
Or right, or strong
This morning belongs to me
Wild and free

The art style is delicate watercolor with subtle ink lines, evoking innocence and boundless potential without any text or human figures present. Square album cover art, no text, no typography.

tracks.title: Pencil Rain
tracks.theme: A gentle lo-fi beat mimicking the rhythmic sound of rain against glass while someone focuses on studying.
tracks.caption: lo-fi hip hop, chill mood, instrumental
tracks.cover_prompt: A cozy, dimly lit study nook at night. Raindrops streak down a large windowpane, blurring the city lights outside into soft bokeh orbs of blue and purple. Inside, warm amber lamps illuminate scattered books, a steaming mug, and a single sharpened pencil resting on an open notebook. The scene exudes a melancholic yet comforting lo-fi aesthetic, with grainy textures and muted, nostalgic colors creating a serene atmosphere of focused tranquility. Square album cover art, no text, no typography.

tracks.title: Neon Tide
tracks.theme: A solitary midnight drive along the coast, blending memories with the glow of neon lights and static radio.
tracks.lyrics:
[verse]
Wind blows cold
On empty roads
Neon bleeds
On ocean nodes
Static hums
In the rearview
Chasing ghosts
Of summer youth

[chorus]
Drive it home
Through the velvet night
Lights reflect
In the fading light
Radio sings
A forgotten tune
Underneath
The moon’s pale spoon

[verse]
Painted lines
Blur to gray
Time stands still
In this way
Tape deck spins
Lost in time
Waves crash deep
On the rim

[chorus]
Drive it home
Through the velvet night
Lights reflect
In the fading light
Radio sings
A forgotten tune
Underneath
The moon’s pale spoon
